# Finessa

> Finessa is a Gut & Liver Health Drink Mix (powder supplement). Finessa is a powdered drink mix built around gut and liver support. Each tub delivers polyphenols, 5 billion CFU of probiotics, dandelion and milk thistle in a single daily scoop you stir into water. One tub holds 50 servings, pricing starts at $39, and every order is backed by a 180-day money-back guarantee. It is designed for people who want a simple daily ritual that addresses digestion and liver wellness together rather than juggling separate probiotic capsules and herbal liver supplements.
